posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked:
Well I see 3 things we can do.

 

  1. NightMist can planar banishment and hope for at least a 2 to destroy the Bonds and Allies of the Earth, as Bubbles aren't really that much of a problem, especially if we knock it down to 1 HP.
  2. Haka can play Ground Pount, that will prevent the non-hero cards from dealing damage until Haka's next turn, meaning we probably won't want to kill any limbs until then, but it will give us a round to destroy the bounds.
  3. Finally, Tachyon with Hypersonic can hit all current targets and prevent damage until the start of her next turn. Since Akash'Bhuta has damage reduction she will not be effected and thus can deal damage to herself with limb destruction.

Any of those are fine by me, as we can't destroy the Bonds in one round using both Tachyon and Tempest.

 

Edit: Option 4, Tempest can Localize Hurricane the Bonds and the Bubbles, Tachyon can follow up with an Accelerated Assualt, leaving Bubbles at 1 HP. Haka will then play a Haka of Shielding discarding 1 card, to reduce the next 2 damage, which should be the Bonds, and thus Haka can deal damage again next round.
